virginia.phase: Statewide industry; operating facilities and proposed expansion have different boundaries.

taxBenefit.status: Company-reported; not independently validated by the reporting agencies
taxBenefit.boundary: Sales/use-tax benefits; state General Fund, non-General Fund and local components. Annual local equipment/property taxes are separate.

health.boundary: Electricity-related air pollution attributed to Virginia data-center demand. Exposed populations can be outside Virginia. Not medical bills, observed deaths or an asthma-case count.

climate.boundary: Present value of future damage from one year's emissions, attributed to Virginia data-center demand. Table 1 published value, not subtraction of rounded totals. Global incidence.

grid.status: JLARC 2024 conditional estimate, not a current bill surcharge
grid.boundary: Typical Dominion residential customer; generation and transmission cost increase in the study's growth scenarios. Not a statewide household estimate. Subsequent tariffs and policies can change incidence.

virginia.modelLimits: Electricity-related damages only; no complete lifecycle, onsite-generator, noise, water or local asthma-cost inventory. Health uses AP4 and mortality-risk valuation; climate uses a social cost of carbon. Sensitive to utilization, grid and valuation assumptions. Host-state attribution is not affected-resident geography.

newMexico.claimStatus: A current $4 million tax incentive to build a data center was not verified in the reviewed sources.
newMexico.phase: Project Jupiter: under construction according to Oracle's October 13, 2026 statement. Financing and permit decisions are separate.

workforce.status: Company commitment; disbursement and binding terms not independently verified

historicalProposal.status: 2019 HB 596 died; 2021 SB 26 record shows no enactment
historicalProposal.boundary: Fiscal analyses said local-government and property-tax-beneficiary revenue losses could exceed $4 million annually and grow. Not a fixed award to a developer or an implemented tax expenditure.

financing.boundary: Documents identify property- and gross-receipts-tax abatements as benefits of the IRB transactions and acknowledge litigation. Aggregate tax benefit, current litigation outcome and complete campus terms not established here. Bond principal is financing capacity, not the value of a tax subsidy.
